links.outcome: Generalisation of heart murmur detection models to out-of-distribution data
links.effect: The abstract reports that the case-study model and other state-of-the-art models generalise with difficulty to out-of-distribution data. No numeric results are given.
links.quote: The difficulty with which this model, and other state-of-the-art models, generalise to out-of-distribution data is also discussed.

unlisted_practices: Applying the NASSS framework to evaluate barriers to deploying AI heart murmur detection in low-income settings

screen.reason: Evaluates a Bayesian ResNet and XGBoost audio/signal screening model on heart murmur recordings in rural Brazil combined with an implementation framework (NASSS) analysis of deployment barriers.
